_doc: PQ-BN direct drive (profiles/metalio-plus-pqbn.json): a flash write requested while the panel converges pauses the drive at a phase boundary instead of waiting for every update to settle (D-36 still holds: no flash operation meets a scan).

display.pqbn.pauses_while_driving.why: the position save after leaving the book lands while the turn and the home screen are still being driven

flash.ops_during_waveform.why: the drive is paused (no scan) while the flash operation runs

storage.wait_for_idle_ms.max.why: a write waits at most ~0.5 s for a quiet panel before it pauses the drive
